Among the seven nations that make up the G‑7, the United Kingdom has the smallest land area.

| G‑7 member | Total area (≈ km²) |
|------------|-------------------|
| Canada | 9,984,670 |
| United States | 9,833,517 |
| France* | 643,801 |
| Japan | 377,975 |
| Germany | 357,386 |
| Italy | 301,340 |
| United Kingdom | **242,495** |

\*France’s figure includes its overseas departments and territories, which are usually counted in official area statistics.

Because 242,495 km² is less than the area of any of the other G‑7 countries, the United Kingdom is the smallest‑area member of the group.
